tables.name: publications
tables.description: One row per source document. Study-level facts only.

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID of this document, taken from the document header line 'PMID:' only.

fields.name: first_author
fields.description: Surname of the first author as printed.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year as printed.

fields.name: study_type
fields.description: Design of this document as stated or evident from its structure.

fields.name: n_patients_reported
fields.description: Number of patients with a TNFAIP3 variant described in this document, as stated by the authors.

fields.name: cohort_size_as_stated
fields.description: (v3, D-22) Total number of patients in the study as the authors state it (e.g. 'a cohort of 49 patients'); null if not stated. People outside the extraction scope (no TNFAIP3 variant or HA20 diagnosis, and not a relative described in relation to an in-scope person) are counted here and get no rows.

fields.name: cites_prior_report_of_same_patients
fields.description: True only if the document states that some of its patients were described in an earlier publication.

fields.name: prior_report_citation
fields.description: The reference (authors, year, PMID or reference number) the document gives for the earlier description of the same patients, verbatim.

tables.name: individuals
tables.description: (v3, D-22) One row per person in scope: everyone the document describes with a TNFAIP3 variant or an HA20 diagnosis, plus relatives the document describes in relation to such a person (tested or affected). Other cohort members get no rows; their number goes in publications.cohort_size_as_stated. Never merge two people. Never invent a person who is not described.

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID of the document this row comes from.

fields.name: individual_label_in_paper
fields.description: (v3, D-22) The label, chosen by this fixed order: (1) the document's own label for the person, verbatim, in the form it uses most (e.g. 'P1', 'Patient 3', 'II-2'); (2) for a relative without an own label, '<relation as written> of <label of the related person>' (e.g. 'mother of P1'); (3) for a table row without a label column, 'Table <n> row <k>' with k counting data rows from the top; (4) for a previously published person described in the text without a label, 'ref <reference as printed> patient' (e.g. 'ref [12] patient'), adding ' 2', ' 3' for further people from the same reference in order of mention; (5) for the single unnamed patient of a case report, 'patient'; (6) otherwise 'unnamed person <k>' in order of first mention.

fields.name: family_label_in_paper
fields.description: Family or pedigree label used by the document, verbatim; 'not reported' if none.

fields.name: is_proband
fields.description: True if the document calls this person the proband or index case, or if they are the single patient of a case report.

fields.name: sex
fields.description: Sex as stated.

fields.name: age_at_onset_original_text
fields.description: Age at symptom onset exactly as written (e.g. '3 months', 'infancy', 'at the age of 12 years'); 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: age_at_onset_iso8601
fields.description: Age at onset as an ISO 8601 duration (P3M, P12Y) only when the original text gives a number; otherwise null.

fields.name: age_at_last_evaluation_original_text
fields.description: Age at the last evaluation or at the time of report, exactly as written; 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: age_at_last_evaluation_iso8601
fields.description: ISO 8601 duration only when a number is given; otherwise null.

fields.name: age_at_diagnosis_original_text
fields.description: Age at diagnosis (clinical or genetic) exactly as written; 'not reported' if absent. Use this, not onset, when the paper gives an age at diagnosis.

fields.name: age_at_diagnosis_iso8601
fields.description: ISO 8601 duration only when the original text gives a number; otherwise null.

fields.name: ethnicity_or_country
fields.description: Ancestry, ethnicity or country of origin as stated; 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: consanguinity
fields.description: Parental consanguinity as stated.

fields.name: vital_status
fields.description: Vital status at last report as stated.

fields.name: deceased_age_iso8601
fields.description: Age at death as ISO 8601 duration if stated; otherwise null.

fields.name: cause_of_death
fields.description: Cause of death as stated; 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: treatment_summary
fields.description: Treatments the document reports for this person, as a short verbatim-based summary; 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: disease_label_as_stated
fields.description: The diagnosis the authors give this person, verbatim (e.g. 'A20 haploinsufficiency', 'Behcet-like disease').

fields.name: clinical_diagnosis_basis
fields.description: How the diagnosis was made per the document (genetic testing, clinical criteria, both), verbatim-based.

fields.name: source_reference_in_review
fields.description: Only for a person taken from a table or summary of previously published cases (for example a review or a literature table in a case report): the reference the document gives for that person, verbatim (reference number, authors and year, or PMID as printed). 'not reported' for people this document describes first-hand.

tables.name: variants
tables.description: One row per (individual, variant). Record variant descriptions exactly as printed; do not convert between cDNA, protein or genomic notation, and do not infer a transcript.

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID of the document this row comes from.

fields.name: individual_label_in_paper
fields.description: Must match the individuals table label for the same person in the same document.

fields.name: gene_symbol_as_stated
fields.description: Gene symbol exactly as printed (expected TNFAIP3; record whatever is printed).

fields.name: variant_original_string
fields.description: The shortest contiguous text that gives the variant description exactly as printed (for example 'c.1727dupC' or 'NM_006290.3:c.653del:p.Leu218TrpfsTer10'). When the paper prints the cDNA, transcript and protein in separate places, record the cDNA (or, failing that, the protein) string here and the other parts in their own fields. (v3, D-22) If the document ties a TNFAIP3 variant to this person but prints no variant description (for example it is only in a figure or an unavailable supplement), keep the row with value 'not reported'; such rows are left out of variant counts and concordance.

fields.name: transcript_as_stated
fields.description: Reference transcript (e.g. NM_006290.3) only if printed; otherwise 'not reported'.

fields.name: cdna_hgvs_as_stated
fields.description: The c. part exactly as printed, if any; otherwise null.

fields.name: protein_hgvs_as_stated
fields.description: The p. part exactly as printed, if any; otherwise null.

fields.name: genomic_coordinates_as_stated
fields.description: Genomic coordinates or g. description exactly as printed, with the genome build if printed; otherwise null.

fields.name: variant_type_as_stated
fields.description: Variant class only as the authors describe it; 'not reported' if they do not.

fields.name: zygosity
fields.description: Zygosity as stated.

fields.name: inheritance
fields.description: Origin of the variant as stated; 'de novo' only if the document says so after parental testing.

fields.name: parental_testing_statement
fields.description: What the document says about testing the parents, verbatim-based; 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: functional_evidence_statement
fields.description: Any functional assay result the document reports for this variant (e.g. NF-kB reporter, protein expression), verbatim-based; 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors
fields.description: The authors' own classification of the variant (e.g. 'pathogenic', 'likely pathogenic', 'VUS', 'novel loss-of-function'), verbatim; 'not reported' if absent.

fields.name: acmg_criteria_as_stated
fields.description: ACMG criteria codes if printed (e.g. PVS1, PS2); otherwise 'not reported'.

tables.name: phenotypic_features
tables.description: One row per (individual, clinical feature) that the document explicitly reports as PRESENT (observed) or explicitly reports as ABSENT (excluded) for that individual. Never emit a row for a feature the document does not mention for that individual.

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID of the document this row comes from.

fields.name: individual_label_in_paper
fields.description: Must match the individuals table label.

fields.name: feature_text_as_stated
fields.description: The clinical feature in the document's own words (e.g. 'recurrent oral ulcers', 'no uveitis').

fields.name: status
fields.description: 'observed' if the document says the individual has or had the feature; 'excluded' only if the document explicitly says the feature was absent, negative or not found in this individual. (v3, D-22) A '-' or similar symbol in a table counts as 'excluded' only when the document's legend or text defines that symbol as absent or negative; quote that definition as a second span. Study inclusion or exclusion criteria (e.g. 'patients with malignancy were excluded') are never evidence about a person's features.

fields.name: evidence_basis
fields.description: 'stated for this individual' when the document says it about this person; 'inferred from group statement' only for a statement that names the group explicitly (e.g. 'only Pt3 of the four had fevers' implies the other three did not).

fields.name: onset_original_text
fields.description: Age or time of onset of this feature exactly as written, if given; otherwise null.

fields.name: onset_iso8601
fields.description: ISO 8601 duration only when a number is given; otherwise null.

fields.name: severity_or_detail
fields.description: Qualifiers the document attaches to the feature (frequency, severity, laboratory value), verbatim-based; otherwise null.

fields.name: hpo_label_candidate
fields.description: The Human Phenotype Ontology term label you believe matches, or null if unsure. This is a candidate only; it is re-bound downstream.

fields.name: hpo_id_candidate
fields.description: The HPO identifier (HP:nnnnnnn) for the candidate label, or null if unsure. Never guess an ID.

tables.name: phenotype_checklist
tables.description: For each individual and each feature in the fixed HA20 checklist below, the three-state status. Emit one row per (individual, checklist feature), always all features. Checklist: oral ulcers; genital ulcers; gastrointestinal ulcers or inflammation; recurrent fever; arthritis or arthralgia; uveitis or other ocular inflammation; skin lesions (rash, folliculitis, erythema nodosum); autoimmune thyroiditis; type 1 diabetes; autoimmune hepatitis; cytopenia (autoimmune); lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy; central nervous system involvement; recurrent infections; elevated inflammatory markers (CRP/ESR); autoantibodies (ANA/other); growth failure; pericarditis or other serositis; interstitial lung disease; vasculitis.

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID of the document this row comes from.

fields.name: individual_label_in_paper
fields.description: Must match the individuals table label.

fields.name: checklist_feature
fields.description: One checklist feature name exactly as listed in the table description.

fields.name: status
fields.description: 'observed' if explicitly reported present; 'excluded' if explicitly reported absent; otherwise 'not reported'. Never use 'excluded' for silence. (v3, D-22) The same rules for table symbols and study criteria apply as in phenotypic_features.

fields.name: evidence_basis
fields.description: Same meaning as in phenotypic_features; 'not reported' when status is 'not reported'.

version: ha20-v3 (2026-10-19, D-22): scope, label order, cohort_size_as_stated, table-symbol and study-criteria rules, variant rows without a printed variant. Derived from schema_ha20_v2.json.
